title: SANA-WM: Efficient Minute-Scale World Modeling with Hybrid Linear Diffusion Transformer
author: Haoyi Zhu; Haozhe Liu; Yuyang Zhao; Tian Ye; Junsong Chen; Jincheng Yu; Tong He; Song Han; Enze Xie
summary: SANA-WM is a new world model that creates 720p videos with precise camera control. It uses hybrid techniques to train efficiently on a single GPU and follow camera movements well. This helps users quickly find and improve video scenes for better quality.
